messages.text: The Eureka 16" Blue Ocean is a desktop model — its gyromatic base and stand are built to sit on a desk or table, not the floor. If you want something with a bit more presence for a desk, it's a great size at 16", with raised relief you can feel across mountain ranges. You'll find it under that same name in the search bar whenever you're ready to add it to your cart.
